mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{tabName})
SELECT HOST_TYPE from BROKER_TOPO_BUSINESS where ASSET_ID = #{assetId} and HOST_TYPE is not null

select a.ID,a.NAME,a.A_B_FLAG,a.SHOW_TOPO,a.IP,a.IP2,a.OS_USER,a.OS_PASSWORD,a.ASSET_MODE,a.MANUFACTURER_ID,a.COLLECTION_TYPE,a.ASSET_IMAGE,a.ORG_ID, a.NTP_FLAG,a.ASSET_CODE,a.IPMI_IP,a.IPMI_USER,a.IPMI_PWD,a.LOGIN_NAME,a.LOGIN_PWD,a.LOGIN_PORT,a.WATCH from asset a left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id
left join station s on o.id = s.org_id
where a.is_del = 1
and (s.ip = #{stationIp} or s.ip2 = #{stationIp})
and o.type = #{type}
and a.id = #{assetId}
and (a.WATCH = 0 or a.WATCH = 1)
and a.WATCH = 1

select a.ID, a.NAME, a.IP, a.SHOW_TOPO, a.ASSET_MODE assetMode, s.IP stationIp, s.PORT stationPort, s.PROXY_URL proxyUrl from asset a left join station s on a.ORG_ID = s.ORG_ID where a.is_del = 1 and watch = 1 and s.STATION_GROUP = #{stationGroup}
